clue.text: Musical slur that flute could begin with

definitions.meaning: in music notation a curved line binding notes together is called by this name
in typesetting the joined letters f and l at the start of a word like flute form a single combined character of this kind

explanation.surface: A musician wonders whether a flute passage might open with a slur.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is typographic: printers join pairs such as fl into one piece of type.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the idea of binding: tied notes in music, and tied letters in printing.

clue.text: Agitation getting university to replace ace theologian

indicators.note: to replace says the university letter takes the place of the ace letter

parts.note: lather means a state of agitation, as in getting into a lather
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A theologian gets worked up when universities swap out top people.
explanation.definitionFit: Martin Luther was the German theologian who began the Protestant Reformation.

clue.text: Stars irritate, lacking clothes in the auditorium

indicators.note: in an auditorium things are heard by an audience, so the words are taken by sound

parts.note: to grate is to irritate; lacking clothes means bare or naked

explanation.surface: An annoyed audience member complains about nudity in a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursa Major is the large northern constellation containing the Plough.

clue.text: Plant work involving man on field?

indicators.note: involving means the word for work wraps around the official

parts.note: toil is hard work
the referee is the official on a sports field

explanation.surface: A gardener toils with a farmer out in the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover and similar three-leaved plants go by this name.

clue.text: Game is little good when there's stone-walling

indicators.note: walling means the gemstone forms a wall around the letter

parts.note: a ruby is a precious stone
G is a short form of good

explanation.surface: A sport sounds barely worthwhile when players stonewall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stone-walling' reads as stalling tactics, but it splits: the stone walls in the G.
explanation.definitionFit: Rugby is the football game played with an oval ball.

clue.text: Blotch created by a black beetle

parts.note: a blotch or blemish on the skin is a scar
B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A dark beetle seems to have left a stain somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarab is a dung beetle, sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Rich man angry when European Union intrudes at various points

indicators.note: at various points means the two letters go in at separate places rather than together
intrudes means the union letters push into the word for angry

parts.note: cross means angry
E is the first letter of the abbreviation EU
U is the second letter of the abbreviation EU

explanation.surface: A wealthy man fumes as Brussels keeps meddling in his affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: E goes after the O of CROSS and U between its two Ss.
explanation.definitionFit: The fabulously wealthy king of Lydia became a byword for riches.

clue.text: Old official set free — fifty and one must go!

indicators.note: must go means the letters for fifty and one are taken away

parts.note: to relieve is to set free from a burden
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A prisoner is released with an odd financial penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval English magistrate or local manorial officer held this title.

clue.text: Nail on wood a collection of timetables

parts.note: a brad is a thin flat nail
a shaw is an old word for a small wood or thicket

explanation.surface: A carpenter drives a nail into timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Bradshaw's Guide was the famous Victorian railway timetable book.

clue.text: It would be unseemly to expose these soldiers

definitions.text: It would be unseemly to expose these
definitions.meaning: a euphemism for the genitals, which decency keeps covered
the lowest rank of enlisted soldiers

explanation.surface: Something it would be indecent to reveal about the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both intimate body parts and ordinary rank-and-file army men.

clue.text: What's slammed as sheer garbage — top musical drama

indicators.note: slammed suggests the words are knocked about violently, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses a prestigious stage show as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slammed' rearranges the letters of SHEER GARBAGE TOP; 'top' looks like praise for the drama but is part of the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: John Gay's 1728 ballad opera is a famous piece of musical theatre.

clue.text: Old piano blocking door? There's a measure of disorder

indicators.note: blocking means the old piano stands in the way inside the doorway, so it goes within

parts.note: a door is an entry
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: An old piano wedged in a doorway makes for a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: In thermodynamics this quantity measures the randomness or disorder of a system.

clue.text: An hour of worship leaves person frayed at the edges

indicators.note: frayed at the edges means the outer letters of the phrase leaves person wear away, leaving its inner run

explanation.surface: A worshipper leaves a service looking worn out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frayed at the edges' strips L from the front and ON from the back of LEAVES PERSON.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening prayer is one of the canonical hours of the Church's daily office.

clue.text: Apartment by hill didn't fulfil expectations

parts.note: a fell is a hill or moor in northern England
an apartment is a flat in British English

explanation.surface: An apartment near a hill turns out to be a disappointment.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a joke or plan that failed to have the hoped-for effect.

clue.text: Thinly cover out-of-this-world creature on rising

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ET is the extraterrestrial from the Spielberg film
an animal is a creature

explanation.surface: An alien beast is covered with a thin layer.
explanation.definitionFit: To bond thin layers or overlay with a sheet of plastic or veneer.

clue.text: Bones discovered in west side of Californian capital

indicators.note: taking only the west side, the left part as written, means the eastern end of the city's name is dropped

parts.note: Sacramento is the state capital of California

explanation.surface: Bones are unearthed in the western part of Sacramento.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the plural of the triangular bone at the base of the spine.

clue.text: Old device with leaking water that would ruin dry places

indicators.note: ruin means the words dry places are wrecked and put back together differently

explanation.surface: An old water clock leaks enough to spoil anywhere dry.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient water clock measured time by the steady escape of water.

clue.text: The Möbius strip is not that devious

parts.words: The Möbius strip is not that
parts.note: a Möbius strip famously has only one side or surface, so it is not the opposite of single-sided

explanation.surface: A twisted loop of paper is surprisingly honest.
explanation.definitionFit: Hypocritical, deceitful people show one face to some and another to others.

clue.text: Caribbean revolutionary set up for broadcast?

parts.note: WI stands for the West Indies, the Caribbean islands
a red is a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A Caribbean rebel is rigged up to go on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Equipment connected with cables or fitted with a microphone is ready to transmit.

clue.text: Drop from ascending eagle? Not half deadly!

indicators.note: ascending in a down clue means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: an eagle is one example of a bird, hence the question mark

indicators.note: not half means only half of the word is kept, here its first half

parts.note: deadly means lethal

explanation.surface: Something falls from a soaring eagle, and it is not half deadly.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny amount or small drop of liquid, a variant of dribble.

clue.text: Lots of people of very mature years given physiotherapy?

parts.note: a mass is a large crowd
being of very mature years means being old

explanation.surface: Crowds of elderly folk receive treatment for their aches.
explanation.definitionFit: Kneading muscles is a typical physiotherapy treatment, hence the question mark.

clue.text: After a game heartless fellow is saying sorry

indicators.note: after says the fellow comes behind the article and game

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the word for fellow is removed

parts.note: a guy is a fellow

explanation.surface: After a match a cold-hearted man is apologising.
explanation.definitionFit: An expression of regret is what one gives when saying sorry.

clue.text: Man asleep possibly made a beastly noise

indicators.note: possibly says asleep is one way a man may be found in bed, so he goes inside it

parts.note: someone asleep is typically in bed
Ray is a man's name

explanation.surface: A sleeping man may have snored like a donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: There is no explicit container word: 'asleep' itself suggests someone lying in bed, and 'possibly' flags that as one way to take it.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey's harsh cry is the classic noise of a beast of burden.

clue.text: Enthusiast keeping quiet, I love the latest thing

indicators.note: keeping means the enthusiast holds the following letters inside

parts.note: an enthusiast is a fan
sh is the call for quiet
love is nil in tennis, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A devotee whispers that they adore the newest craze.
explanation.definitionFit: A current trend or vogue is the newest style everyone follows.

clue.text: Stop facility for trade

definitions.meaning: to stop, as an engine does when it cuts out
a market booth or stand where goods are sold

explanation.surface: A shop is closed down, a place of business halted.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to halt and a market trader's booth.

clue.text: Angel making track across northern sky initially

indicators.note: across means the track stretches over the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: a spoor is the track or trail of an animal

indicators.note: initially means only the opening letter of sky is used

explanation.surface: An angel blazes a trail across the northern heavens.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre slang an angel is a financial backer of a production.

clue.text: Its queen arrived, a woman with a degree

parts.note: she is a pronoun standing for a woman
BA is a Bachelor of Arts degree

explanation.surface: A female graduate makes a regal entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: Handel's 'The Arrival of the Queen of Sheba' is the reference.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical kingdom whose queen visited Solomon, celebrated in Handel's piece.

clue.text: Old character to get destroyed by unknown assassin in France

indicators.note: destroyed means the words old character to are wrecked and rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: Y is a mathematical unknown, as in algebra

explanation.surface: An ancient figure is brought down by a mysterious killer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' rearranges OLD CHARACTER TO; then Y is added.
explanation.definitionFit: She stabbed the revolutionary Jean-Paul Marat in his bath in 1793.

clue.text: Swell little woman to meet after hours

parts.note: Di is a short form of the woman's name Diana
after hours means late at night

explanation.surface: A nice little woman arranges a late-night rendezvous.
explanation.definitionFit: To widen or expand, as pupils do, is to swell in size.

clue.text: Irish boy jumping over lake in frenzied state

indicators.note: in puts the boy and lake inside the word for frenzied

parts.note: frenzied means mad

indicators.note: jumping over means the boy straddles the lake, so it sits within his name

parts.note: Ryan is a typical Irish boy's name
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A wild Irish lad leaps across a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumping over' pictures the boy straddling the lake, so his name spans it, rather than a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the fifty US states, on the Atlantic coast.
